metadata.scope: Node-local analytical 3D Darcy application; explicitly selected complete acquisitions with reused native workspace resources and independent material solves.
metadata.resource_policy: MHM windows expose all 32 physical cores (affinity 0..31), with one native thread per spawned worker. Classical strong scaling assigns one physical core to each MPI rank (affinity 0..P-1 for P ranks); matched 32-rank comparisons use all 32 cores. Competing project native benchmarks run in separate timing windows.
metadata.timing_policy: Parent launch/import/native initialization, fresh independent workflow, local solves/transfers, synchronization, global solve and reconstruction included. Compiler cache warmed separately. Norm integration and archive/plot writing excluded. Actual native pipeline totals and startup retained separately.
metadata.sample_policy: One explicitly selected accepted acquisition per configuration, no variance or confidence interval estimate. Replaced or excluded raw acquisitions are not counted as additional statistical samples.

discretization.volume_space: conforming Q1 within each hexahedral macrocell
discretization.trace_space: four tensor-Q1 modes on each unsplit quadrilateral macroface
discretization.kernel: declared constant; physical-volume moments for local responses
discretization.global_gauge: none with full zero pressure Dirichlet data
discretization.physical_flux: broken -K grad(p_h); no H(div) or fine-cell conservation claim

materials.period0.137: nonaligned material; independently assembled distinct operators

metadata.workspace_reuse: Per-worker/thread mesh, spaces, compiled native UFL forms, buffers; application-only geometry B/C reuse. Every macrocell assembles its own A/f and constructs its own factors/hierarchy/source/trace responses. No material or response caching.
metadata.kernel_residual_convention: The retained-action RHS is roundoff-scale for the declared constant kernel; its relative quotient is retained separately from physical source/trace and reconstructed-equation criteria.
metadata.weak_policy: Expand integer x-domain at fixed H=.25, h=1/64, coefficient wavelength and trace degree. Separate four- and eight-macrocell-per-worker families, using their smallest actually measured process count as baseline.

literature.scope: Independent local responses and coupled assembly; published tetrahedral P2 cluster timing experiment differs.
Cost-aware scheduling; no transferred timing gains claimed.

reference_projects.scope: Executed independent conforming Q1 UFL reference; analytical application, not external MHM reference code.
Executed distributed classical algebra and COMM_SELF local direct factors.
Native elements and reference Q1 trace/field tabulation.

limitations: Equal element and CPU budgets do not imply equal global approximation spaces or equal accuracy.
Fixed macro/trace local-refinement sweep is not full MHM convergence.
Cube Q1 application; no simplex theorem or literature figure reproduction claim.
Focused node-local strong/weak observations; no multi-node efficiency claim.
No accepted complete128-per-axis or large GPU timing.
metadata.basis_archives: Every MHM receipt binds its actual executed E, original A/B/f and coefficient vectors via SHA-256; replay/norm controls follow outside solve timers.
metadata.timing_scope: Inclusive launch/import/native initialization, local setup/assembly/independent factors or hierarchies, response transfer, ordered global assembly, global solve and reconstruction; independent error integration and archival are outside timers.

scientific_controls.other_states: Actual original-row/basis/BLAS1and2/sign-rotation controls; no additional physical integral assigned when null.

result.selection: Default MUMPS r1 only, following concurrency qualification of r0; fresh quiet GAMG and nonaligned MUMPS/GAMG r0. One accepted competitive acquisition per selected configuration; no statistical variance claim.
result.scope: Same Q1 hexahedral strong full zero Dirichlet problem per period; no pressure mean gauge, raw q=-K grad(p); setup/transfers/synchronization/gather and native initialization included. Error integration after timing. Comparisons with MHM are at equal element/resource budgets, different global approximation spaces.

result.method: conforming Q1 primal Galerkin, PETSc CG/GAMG
result.fixed_fine_mesh: 64 cubical Q1 cells per unit length in each direction
result.scaling_scope: Fixed physical problem and constrained Q1 space; one native thread per MPI rank. Each point uses fresh processes, mesh, matrix and AMG hierarchy after separate persistent-JIT warmup.
result.measurement_statistics: One acquisition per MPI rank budget; no variance estimate or repeated-acquisition statistical claim.
result.norm_scope: Own native norms are present only where actually integrated; other points preserve actual coefficient agreement and original physical residual checks instead of borrowing another field's norm.

result.scope: Completed controls use only actual literal archived arrays and unchanged replay/physical norm owners; no new native assembly, solver acquisition or numerical basis computation. The first two initial controls are retained unchanged. Individual control cpu_affinity values are start-of-receipt snapshots; the bound companion records actual subsequent all-thread transitions and UTC epochs.

post_timing_resource_provenance.scope: Scientific checks and actual field integration after every competitive timer had closed; initial snapshot and any later resource transition are recorded separately.

result.scope: Authorised resource expansion applies only to archived-state scientific controls after every competitive timer closed; numerical formulas, BLAS2 configuration, accepted acquisition receipts and archived coefficients are unchanged.
result.control_snapshot_convention: A control's cpu_affinity is the snapshot recorded near its start. For an already-running process this companion records the actual subsequent all-thread affinity transition and UTC epoch. New control processes are expanded during initialization.
